verdict.rationale: Docs show Terminal is built API-first: readers can be registered, located, and managed via API (docs-4, docs-5, docs-13, docs-20, docs-43), payments, tipping and receipts can be driven via API (docs-7, docs-8, docs-23, docs-29, docs-34, docs-42), and refunds can be issued via the Refunds API as well as the Dashboard (docs-28). This indicates strong API/UI parity for core POS operations. However, some functions are explicitly Dashboard-centric (reader ordering, monitoring per docs-32) and Stripe also offers a distinct 'no-code' path (docs-3, docs-21, docs-26, docs-31) implying certain workflows are designed to be UI-only rather than API-equivalent. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that reader ordering/monitoring and fleet-wide dashboard features are fully API-accessible, and independent hands-on evidence of full parity.
